import { Component, OnInit } from '@angular/core'; import { Router } from '@angular/router'; import { AuthService } from '../../services/auth.service'; @Component({ selector: 'app-redirect', templateUrl: './redirect.component.html', styleUrls: ['./redirect.component.scss'] }) export class RedirectComponent implements OnInit { constructor( private router: Router, private authService: AuthService ) { } refreshPage(): void { window.location.reload(); } ngOnInit(): void { // Check if user has a valid token, if so redirect to home if (this.authService.isAuthenticated()) { this.router.navigate(['/home']); } } tryAgain(): void { // Try to re-authenticate this.authService.ensureValidSession(); } }

Access Required

This application requires authentication through the Clienta app.

Please open this page through the Clienta application to access your health data.

How to access:

  1. 1. Open the Clienta app
  2. 2. Navigate to Health Count
  3. 3. Click to open this application

If you continue to have issues, please contact your administrator.
